title: temnadenia pallidiflora
intro: Temnadenia pallidiflora, commonly known as the "Yellow Mandevilla", is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It is traditionally used in Brazilian folk medicine for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating symptoms of anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The health benefits of Temnadenia pallidiflora are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anxiolytic, sedative, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
